findings.explanation: The bundled sas_print_table() writer may have accepted an HTML destination and written PDF bytes. The writer should reject destinations outside its PDF contract.
findings.expected: The PDF-only helper raises a format error before creating the file.
findings.uncertainty: The file header and exact helper behavior need to be checked on the reported runtime.
findings.next_step: Run the proposed example using the affected package build and compare with the current build.
